plain_text:
CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
LOWELL, MASSACHUSETTS 
October 14, 2026 
Note: These minutes are not completed verbatim. For further detail, video recordings are available at 
the Pollard Library, second floor reference desk or online at www.LTC.org. 
This meeting was held both in person and virtually using Zoom. 
Members Present:  Vice Chair Perry Downs, Commissioner Marie Burns , Commissioner Krist in Ross-
Sitcawich, Commissioner Roberto Ciccarelli 
Members Absent: Chairman Brad Buitenhuys 
Others Present: Mary Brundage, Associate Planner 
CALL TO ORDER 
P. Downs called the meeting to order at 6:30 PM with a quorum of members present. 
ORDER OF BUSINESS 
CONTINUED BUSINESS 
Request for Determination of Applicability  
Winnco 
50 Braintree Hill Office Park, Suite 304 
Braintree, MA 02184  
Project Location: 451 Black Brook Drive, 01851 
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by Winnco seeking approval to clean out the 
existing culvert at 451 Black Brook Drive. The work will take place within the 100-foot buffer zone of a 
protected wetland. 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
In Favor: 
None 
 
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
P. Downs noted that this application has been on the agenda for a while, and the work seems to be a 
bigger project than anticipated. M. Burns agreed and that any future work would need a NOI.
Motion: 
M. Burns motioned to issue a positive 3 determination. K. Ross-Sitcawich seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (4-0). 
 
Request for Determination of Applicability 
CSX Transportation 
500 Water Street 
Jacksonville, FL 32202 
Project Location: Lowell Train Tack Right-Of-Way 
A Request for Determination of Applicability has been filed by CSX Transportation, Inc, regarding their 
plans for weed control via herbicide. The applicant is seeking to determine where the proposed work is 
located within the 100-foot buffer zone of a wetland resource area. 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
In Favor: 
None 
 
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
P. Downs mentioned that applicant had requested a continuance. 
 
Motion: 
M. Burns motioned to continue to the 10/28 meeting. K. Ross-Sitcawich seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (4-0). 
 
Enforcement Order 
Alish and Jigarkumar Bhagat 
4 Epirus Drive 
Lowell, MA 01854 
Violation Location: 4 Epirus Drive, 01854 
An Enforcement Order has been issued against 4 Epirus Drive. The violator has cut trees within the 100-
feet of a Bordering Vegetated Buffer (BVW). 
 
On Behalf: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
P. Downs mentioned that the site visit has been conducted. It looks like some of the trees are dead and 
there is some debris left. P. Downs stated he would need to hear from the violator who is in not 
attendance. 
 
Motion: 
M. Burns motioned to continue to the 10/28 meeting. R. Ciccarelli seconded the motion. The motion 
passed unanimously, (4-0).
NEW BUSINESS 
 
OTHER BUSINESS  
 
9/23/2026 meeting minutes 
K. Ross-Sitcawich motioned to continue to the 10/28 meeting. R. Ciccarelli seconded the motion. The 
motion passed unanimously, (4-0). 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
M. Burns motioned to adjourn. R. Ciccarelli seconded the motion. The meeting adjourned at 6:34 PM.
